description:
Project Overview

The Institute of Molecular and Clinical Ophthalmology Basel (IOB) offers fully funded PhD and MD-PhD positions through its PhD and MD-PhD Program in Translational Neurosciences. The programme, launched in 2022, provides outstanding young scientists the opportunity to pursue cutting-edge research at the interface of basic science, clinical research, and translational medicine.

PhD students at IOB work across a diverse range of topics and disciplines, from computational science and neuroscience to molecular biology, genetics, translational research, and clinical research.

Research position overview

This fully funded programme includes access to a comprehensive training environment, with candidates enrolled at the University of Basel. Research focuses on vision science, disease mechanisms, and therapeutic development.

Research Areas

  • Translational neuroscience and vision research
  • Retinal biology and disease mechanisms
  • Computational neuroscience and data science
  • Molecular biology and genetics
  • Therapeutic development for visual disorders
